title: Government Of India Act 1935
definition: A landmark constitutional enactment by the British Parliament that provided a blueprint for a federal system in India, established provincial autonomy, and served as the primary constitutional prototype for independent India's Constitution.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (direct statutory features, division of powers, electoral provisions) and Mains GS-1 & GS-2 (evolution of constitutional framework, administrative legacy, national movement milestones).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Government Of India Act 1935.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
